id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

where and how to render these notifications.

filterString.description:
A string that can be used to filter the connectors by {@link SelfServiceDI.Ui.DataConnector#label} and/or
{@link SelfServiceDI.Ui.DataConnector#provider}.

showInfoSidePanel.description:
Whether the component should show the side panel with information about the selected card.
If true, the side panel will be shown.
